title: Weekend Recovery SLA Attainment
dataSources: Cross-stream correlations (`correlation:pair`), anomaly-day rollups (`anomalyday:score`), personal SLA checks (`personalsla:status`), and daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`).
app: Meta-monitoring for every `index=personal` stream, turning cross-signal correlations, anomaly-day scoring, and personal SLA dashboards into Splunk-native analytics.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalsla:status
| search sla_domain="recovery" weekend=true
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(status="met")) as successful by _time sla_name
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for weekend recovery SLAs by SLA.
value: Weekend attainment tells you whether the days meant for recovery are actually doing their job.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for weekend recovery SLAs events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for weekend recovery SLAs by SLA.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how often weekend recovery SLAs works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
